title: viola tricolor var. orcadensis
intro: Viola tricolor var. orcadensis, commonly known as the Orkney or common pansy, is a perennial plant species belonging to the violet family (Violaceae). It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, such as colds, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Viola tricolor var. orcadensis include its use as a diaphoretic to induce sweating, a diuretic to increase urine production, and a vulnerary to promote wound healing, as well as its potential to calm the nervous system and reduce anxiety. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and anthraquinones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
